in_marathi.name: Jayshree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayshree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya (victory) + Ishree (goddess), representing the victory of Goddess Ishwara or Saraswati. In Hindu mythology, Jayshree is an epithet of various goddesses, particularly Saraswati.
